name: Kisköre (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged at the centre with the town arms of Kisköre (a blue and green shield with a fish, a star and a ploughshare, within a green wreath) below the name KISKÖRE in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated border of red and green triangles
